LH-SU 10-19 SAFE successor of w (route hbm_su_cx_ijq_1018w-rw-136f736ca NEEDS_RTL TT -73.23 / FF +25.2 / DRC 0; worst ioh[13] -> ob0[99], 77 violating D pins): the 16->4 x 256b gather was ONE cycle of a 64-bit onehot (ioh, each bit 256 loads) gating 16 sources into a 16-way OR. SAFE_GATHER=1 (HBM-LINK-RECOVERY d8afaa78e + LH-SU r3): stage 1 = 8 kept COPY_ID paramod onehot copies (64 b each, 512 kept onehot flops, each bit 32 loads) gate 4 local sources into registered 32b partials pq (replace the 4,096 iq capture flops, same edge); stage 2 = OR of 4 registered partials into ob0/ob1 at the existing bank-write edge. Control delay (>=3 deep) is a circular 20b ring with one-hot write/read selects; each gather copy registers its own 20b control word (ring read one slot ahead, so the registered word equals the old combinational one: 0 added edges) and decodes it with equality compares. 65 kept bank-select copies (64 ob x 32 enables + 1 for the jb read mux). Generic-Yosys all-module census r3 (results/rtl/cxijq_safe_1019/r3/fanout_all.json): 8 copies x 85 FF survive; every non-clock, non-reset net <= 33 loads (r2 had 63-131 on ctl_v / the shared ohdec adder, rp[0] 65). Ports, faces, outline 216 x 388.8 (ij_s seam pair 324 x 388.8), pin ranges, latency and calendar unchanged. Equivalence vs legacy ij_q (itself lockstep vs the hub) Verilator 5.050: SD0/SD2 PASS 13365/13347 checks; mutants 4/5/6 FAIL. CX-IJ 10-18: the two-root ij leaf carries two 3:4 crossings inside one leaf (ijd_slot clk_s -> ipv / ipgb / ibad clk_q, and io_slot clk_q -> idl clk_s, 3 x 1,024 b), the defect that failed routes hbm_su_cx_dl_1017-s2-761317600 (TT -166.7 / FF -95.1) and hbm_su_cx_rc_1017-s2-761317600 (TT -173.4 / FF -77.9): related-clock STA times a 3:4 crossing at the VCO tick (setup 277.8 ps, coincident-edge hold) less the 150 / 100 distinct-entry reserve. Fix (dl/rc split, S81 x34 _s/_t precedent): one root per half; the crossings become 2-bank seams (static calendar windows >= 3 quanta for setup and rewrite-after-read), die-level 3:4 seam arcs. Lockstep vs the hub on Verilator 5.050 PASS QID 2 and QID 0 (checks=24183); mutants 1/2/3/4 FAIL. ij_q (serial, x1 per quarter): E seam to ij_s 2,114 b (5.6/um); the four slices port-5 data 4,096 b on W (inj_q0/1, 5.4/um), S (inj_q2, 4.9/um) and N (inj_q3, 4.9/um, clock/reset/fault at the NE end beside the ob seam banks). HH-1 10-18 regate: 388.8 x 388.8 -> 216 x 388.8 (gate 388.8^2: pin flops ring a 389 um square, TT / FF pin-flop spread 97.2 / 92.7 ps > 80, util 2.7%); the ring now spans 216 x 389 um. Variant u: unclustered TritonCTS H-tree over the pin-band sinks (qkd_d2d_static 10-15 precedent: sparse pin-band tile, unclustered tree 442..508 ps). RE-PLAN TW2-CXIJ 10-19 (route hbm_su_cx_ijq_1018-x1-ac1057e3b + gates ijq/ijq_u: trial GRT needed 5/30 extra congestion iterations, total wire 1,549 mm in 216x388.8, M3 45%/M2 33% vs M4/M5 10%/9%): the wire is the 16->4 chunk gather itself (each of 4,096 inj bits feeds the 4 output quarters 45 um apart on E, each iword bit feeds ob0[i] and ob1[i] 182 um apart), and placement packed it into ONE diagonal band (the ob0/ob1 midpoints, ~0.5 bin density) plus a 4-column E pin-flop band at density >= 1.0 (2,048 ob flops at 5.4 pins/um). Fix: unclustered CTS (u: TT/FF spread 33.1/33.3), E/W pin-flop bands 8 columns deep (half the density), gather band spread by routability-driven global placement (GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN on, pd 0.50; ports, faces, outline, RTL and the 324x388.8 pair unchanged).
